title: “Night Sweats”, acrylic painting by me.
content: You finally found the exit. You push through the clunky metal door and find yourself immersed in the sticky darkness. The air is so thick it’s almost hard to walk through, and for some reason it smells like the Pirates of the Caribbean ride and Disney Land. It’s late. Or early. Either way, you’re pretty sure you have a math test in the morning.
